Rainbow Butterfly 1.notes: Wing fold. For MilkDrop2077 - Rainbow Butterfly1, whose own warp shader is a stub because MD3 PRO renders it from cache.

Rainbow Butterfly 2.notes: Kaleidoscope tunnel. Butterfly2's MD31 resolves into a different PRO cache than Butterfly1's, so the pair is meant to differ.

MD31 Family.notes: Mild general-purpose warp for MilkDrop2077 presets whose own warp shader is a stub because MD3 PRO renders theirs from cache.
